notes.title: Soundtrack available for free!
notes.content: MMM's soundtrack made by the talented Kent Weiler is now available to download and listen to for free over at Kent's [url=https://soundcloud.com/enteiler/sets/mmm-murder-most-misfortunate-ost]Soundcloud[/url] page. Take a seat, plug in your headphones, and enjoy!

notes.title: MMM Full Release
notes.content:
After nearly 2 years of development, we're happy to finally release it! We've put a lot of effort into this, and we hope you'll enjoy it!

If you're not sure what this game is, try out our free demo!

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content: You can now download a demo of the game from the Steam page. The demo contains the first (of three) chapters of MMM. It's avilable for Windows, Linux & Mac.
